claims.claim: An explosion in mid-October at Intel Fab 28 near Kiryat Gat killed two people, seriously injured one, and shut the fab for about two weeks.
claims.episode_span: An explosion in mid-October at Intel’s Fab 28 near Kiryat Gat, Israel, killed two people and seriously injured one
claims.source_title: Deadly Intel Fab 28 explosion causes two-week shutdown, to cost $600 million
claims.supporting_quote: The explosion occurred in mid-October, killed two, seriously injured one, and caused an extended shutdown of Fab 28

claims.claim: Intel expects about $300 million of lost revenue in Q4 2026 and about $300 million in Q1 2027 from the Fab 28 shutdown, almost all of it related to 10nm server products, plus about a 2 percent hit to Q4 non-GAAP gross margin.
claims.episode_span: He put the revenue hit at about $300 million in the fourth quarter of 2026 and a similar $300 million in the first quarter of 2027
claims.source_title: Deadly Intel Fab 28 explosion causes two-week shutdown, to cost $600 million
claims.supporting_quote: Please note almost all of the $300 impact from Fab 28 is related to 10nm server products

claims.claim: Intel's Q3 2026 revenue was $16.5 billion, up 21 percent, Data Center and AI revenue was $7.3 billion, up 78 percent, and client revenue was $8.1 billion, down 5 percent.
claims.episode_span: Data Center and AI revenue was $7.3 billion, up 78 percent
claims.source_title: Intel Q3 2026 Earnings Data Center Soars While PC Faces Memory Pressure
claims.supporting_quote: The Data Center and AI (DCAI) group delivered $7.3 billion in revenue, up 78% year-over-year.

claims.claim: Intel expects the PC market to shrink about 12 percent in units this year and sees another 10 percent decline in 2027.
claims.episode_span: Intel expects the PC market to shrink about 12 percent in units this year and sees another 10 percent decline in 2027
claims.source_title: Intel Data Center Revenue Jumps 78%, but Weak Q4 Guidance Drags Stock Down 30%
claims.supporting_quote: On the earnings call, the company said it expects the PC market to shrink by about 12% in units this year, and it reportedly sees another 10% decline in 2027.

claims.claim: GIGABYTE's WRX90 AI TOP has seven PCIe 5.0 x16 slots, two MCIO 8i connectors, support for up to nine GPUs, and up to 2 TB of ECC DDR5.
claims.episode_span: It has seven PCIe 5.0 x16 slots and two MCIO 8i connectors, which GIGABYTE says can support up to nine GPU devices
claims.source_title: GIGABYTE Advances Local AI Infrastructure with WRX90 AI TOP Motherboard
claims.supporting_quote: Equipped with seven PCIe 5.0 x16 slots and two MCIO 8i connectors, the motherboard offers extensive bandwidth capable of supporting up to nine GPU devices through compatible expansion hardware.

claims.claim: PsiQuantum's eight-port optical switch typically loses 1.2 dB, under a quarter of its light, where data centers allow up to 3 dB.
claims.episode_span: The eight-port device typically loses 1.2 dB — under a quarter of its light — against a data-center allowance of up to 3 dB.
claims.source_title: PsiQuantum turns its photonics know-how into an optical switch
claims.supporting_quote: PsiQuantum’s eight-port optical switch typically loses 1.2 dB, under a quarter of its light, where data centers allow up to 3 dB.

claims.claim: Google bought 56 hectares in Hamina, Finland; Tekova plans a 50 MW data center in Perho; SRV backed out of a 40 MW project in Eura.
claims.episode_span: Tekova plans an announced 50-megawatt data center in Perho, and SRV has backed out of a 40-megawatt project in Eura.
claims.source_title: Google buys 56 hectares in Hamina, Finland
claims.supporting_quote: Finnish firm Tekova plans 50MW data center in Perho, SRV backs out of 40MW project in Eura

claims.claim: A criminal investigation was launched into environmental damage from Google's Finnish subsidiary related to Muhos tree-felling.
claims.episode_span: a criminal investigation into environmental damage tied to Google’s Finnish subsidiary
claims.source_title: Google hit with criminal probe over unapproved AI data center deforestation
claims.supporting_quote: A criminal investigation into the environmental damage caused by Google’s Finnish subsidiary has been launched.

claims.claim: PowerBank plans a 2 MW modular data center in Ontario and has signed a first lease with an AI cloud partner.
claims.episode_span: PowerBank’s 2-megawatt modular data center in Ontario, Canada, is announced.
claims.source_title: PowerBank plans 2MW modular data center in Ontario, Canada
claims.supporting_quote: Signs first lease with AI cloud partner

claims.claim: DayOne signed an MoU with Sembcorp on power and energy for APAC data centers under Bring Your Own Power, and an MoU with Blue Whale Energy to study a distributed virtual power plant in Singapore for SG1.
claims.episode_span: DayOne has signed a memorandum of understanding with Sembcorp to integrate power and energy solutions across Asia-Pacific data centers
claims.source_title: DayOne inks MoU with Blue Whale Energy
claims.supporting_quote: Would support DayOne's SG1 data center

claims.claim: TSMC Arizona employs more than 3,500 people, projects 6,000 for the first three fabs, reports second-fab construction complete inside a $265 billion site investment, and expects more than 100 equipment technician hires by the end of 2026.
claims.episode_span: construction of the second fab is now complete within a site investment that now totals $265 billion
claims.source_title: From Fire Watch to Fab Tools: The First Graduates of an ASU Program Built for TSMC Arizona
claims.supporting_quote: Construction of the second fab is now complete, AZ Big Media reported after TSMC’s Oct. 15 earnings call, part of a site investment that now totals $265 billion.

claims.claim: Sherman is reported as the leading candidate for a TSMC fab that could mean $120 billion, while state documents describe an unnamed firm seeking $45 billion for two Texas plants and Bloomberg has reported up to six DFW facilities at $20 billion each.
claims.episode_span: Sherman has been identified as the leading candidate for TSMC’s next fabrication plant, which the Dallas Business Journal reported could bring a $120 billion investment.
claims.source_title: Sherman Is Likely Contender For TSMC Semiconductor Expansion
claims.supporting_quote: Sherman has been identified as the leading candidate to score Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s next massive fabrication facility, which could bring an investment of $120B, the Dallas Business Journal reported.

claims.claim: Sam Altman said it is quite terrible for people to have RAM in their own PCs when it could go into AI data centers.
claims.episode_span: Sam Altman said it is “quite terrible” for people to have RAM in their own PCs when that memory could go into AI data centers
claims.source_title: OpenAI CEO says it's 'quite terrible' for your PC to have RAM
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in a podcast interview that "it's quite terrible" for people to have RAM in their own PCs when it could go into AI data centers.

claims.claim: China imposed export controls in April 2025 on seven rare earths, and Taiwan's ITRI targets a demonstration plant by the end of 2028 and 500 tons a year by the end of 2030, about 50 percent of domestic demand.
claims.episode_span: annual production of 500 tons of rare earths by the end of 2030
claims.source_title: TSMC Weighs Rare-Earth-Free Motors Amid China's Export Controls
claims.supporting_quote: The facility is targeted for completion by the end of 2028, with annual production of 500 tons of rare earths by the end of 2030.

claims.claim: China postponed until November 10, 2026, implementation of some expanded rare-earth controls announced in October 2025.
claims.episode_span: Some expanded Chinese rare-earth control measures announced in October 2025 stay postponed until November 10, 2026
claims.source_title: TSMC Weighs Rare-Earth-Free Motors Amid China's Export Controls
claims.supporting_quote: China postponed until November 10, 2026, the implementation of some measures announced in October to expand the controls.
